skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target, and deals an additional 10% of Max HP as bonus damage.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single target, and deals an additional 15% of Max HP as bonus damage.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to deal an additional 15% of Max HP as bonus damage to the primary target, and a 50% chance to deal it to targets in the same column as the primary target.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. After an ally in the same column attacks, immediately launches a [Follow-up] (attacks with 80% of Basic Attack's damage and effects).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. After an ally in the same column attacks, immediately launches a [Follow-up] (attacks with 80% of Basic Attack's damage and effects).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. After an ally in the same column attacks, immediately launches a [Follow-up] (attacks with 115% of Basic Attack's damage and effects).

effects.desc: Extra attack outside of turn. Disabled by [Lock] and [Blind].
